Soros on the concept of reflexivity, in "New Money Masters" -- one of the best single-page summaries available on the topic

"Perceptions change events, which in turn change perception."

"Speculators have always understood it, but not necessarily the public."

"Timing...is imperfect. The 'fog of war' prevents you from having all the information you would like, and by the time you have it, the situation has changed."

"Soros is particularly interested in two areas of reflexivity: relationships b/w lending and collateral, and b/w regulators and the economy."
